description: Eight attack-decay envelope generators, each with its own VCA, and a unity mixer across them. A column of GLOBAL controls sets or triggers all eight at once

params.text: The attack time of all eight envelopes
The decay time of all eight envelopes
Switches all eight envelopes between a linear curve and an exponential one
Makes that channel's envelope start again as soon as it finishes, so it runs continuously
Switches that channel's signal into the unity mix
The attack time of that channel's envelope
The decay time of that channel's envelope
Switches that channel's envelope between a linear curve, marked LIN, and an exponential one, marked EXP

inputs.text: A CV modulating the attack time of all eight envelopes
A CV modulating the decay time of all eight envelopes
A pulse triggers that channel's envelope
A pulse triggers all eight envelopes
The signal that channel's VCA passes
A signal fed to all eight VCAs

outputs.text: That channel's envelope as a voltage
A pulse when that channel's attack reaches the top
A pulse when that channel's envelope finishes
The unity mix of the channels switched into it
That channel's input signal shaped by its envelope
The GLOBAL column's jack on the VCA OUT row. No source says what it carries; every other control in that column acts on all eight channels at once

menu: Channel one is poly — turns the first channel's ports into eight channel polyphonic ports, so the module works as one polyphonic attack-decay envelope with its VCA
